failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 3: 'When was the 2PM music video "Take Off" released, and did this release date occur after Jay Park left 2PM in early 2010?' This is a compound natural-language yes/no question bundling two targets (release date verification AND temporal comparison) rather than a well-formed retrieval query with a clear target entity.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'When was the 2PM music video "Take Off" released?' Query at hop 3: 'When was the 2PM music video "Take Off" released, and did this release date occur after Jay Park left 2PM in early 2010?' Both queries target the same information (Take Off release date) with near-identical core intent. Hop 2 already retrieved the Take Off (2PM song) passage containing the May 18, 2011 release date, yet hop 3 re-asks the same question.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 1 solver reasoning, the agent processes passages about Michelle Lee (singer), Bohemian (band), Park Kwang-su (filmmaker), and Son Jun-ho (actor) - passages [3-7] - none of which are relevant to verifying the claim about Jay Park, Lee Jun-ho (the 2PM member), and the Take Off video. Resources spent analyzing these tangential documents.
